result.reason: The broad project/product non-compete is deleted, but the operative clause still grants HDI an exclusive field-of-use right for the Deerskin brand on a direct-to-consumer website, so it does not reach the preferred position. It also does not implement the fallback carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions. Deleting the Section 6.2 exception unnecessarily broadens the retained exclusivity and alters unrelated commercial intent. The phrase “exclusive right to use of” is also grammatically awkward.
